angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 403,506 km at 72.93 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.7113 +/- 0.0154 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 72.93 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.58 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-155 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract): 403,506 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.65 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-155 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4258 +/- 150 K from Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-155 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Díez Alonso et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-155 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-155.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.724, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-155 (pscomppars): spectral type K7, from Luo et al. 2018 (http://vizier.u-strasbg.fr/viz-bin/VizieR-3?-source=V/153/stellar4)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LP 415-17: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-155 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.3 dex, from Díez Alonso et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-155 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.22915, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-155 (pscomppars): rotation period 34.8 d, from Díez Alonso et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.476L..50D/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/MNRAS/520/5283/table1 (Rotation periods and ages of cool host stars), column Prot: 24.66 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, LP 415-17: projected rotation speed 1.2 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2023A&A...676A..90R)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
